about.title: Sansevieria: The Collection of Dr. Horst Pfennig
about.firstSection:
My husband was interested in the genus Sansevieria from an early age, in addition to his profession. After he found that there was very little literature on this group of plants, he decided in the 1960s to deal with it more intensively and to collect it. 
 
 This initially happened through contacts with other collectors and botanical gardens (Pf 0001 - Pf 0247). Since 1971, he then traveled to East Africa (Kenya, Tanzania, Uganda and Rwanda) to collect the plants - in addition to Sansevieria also other succulent plants and orchids - at their locations (Pf 1001 - Pf 1743):
